items.headline: ServiceNow Has Biggest-Ever Drop After Sales Outlook Disappoints
items.excerpt: ServiceNow Inc. shares suffered a record intraday drop after the company gave an outlook for quarterly subscription sales that met analysts’ estimates, but failed to quell Wall Street’s anxieties that artificial intelligence will disrupt the software maker.

items.headline: Google Drops a Record 13% After Sales Miss Sparks AI Skepticism
items.excerpt: Alphabet Inc.’s shares fell more than 13%, for its biggest-ever market value wipeout, after the company reported disappointing search and advertising sales that reinforced investor concerns about AI’s threat to its core business.

items.headline: Microsoft’s Surging Cloud Sales Show AI Spending Paying Off
items.excerpt: Microsoft Corp. posted increasing growth in its cloud business and kept its capital expenditures in check, satisfying investors amid a drumbeat of concern that spending on artificial intelligence won’t pay off.

items.headline: Microsoft Eyes at Least $25 Billion in First US Bond Since 2017
items.excerpt: Microsoft Corp. is looking to raise at least $25 billion from its first US investment-grade bond sale in more than nine years, joining rivals in a relentless borrowing spree to fund the artificial intelligence boom.

items.headline: DoorDash Makes $17 Billion Bet on Groceries With Instacart Deal
items.excerpt: DoorDash Inc. agreed to buy rival Instacart in a deal that values the company at about $17 billion, the latest sign of consolidation in an increasingly competitive delivery market.

items.headline: Anthropic IPO May Spark AI Rally as Short Bets on Tech Pile Up
items.excerpt: Wall Street’s recent risk aversion toward stocks may have created an opening for a sharp rebound, particularly in technology shares, if Anthropic PBC’s planned initial public offering reignites enthusiasm for artificial intelligence.

items.headline: US Stock Futures Today: Alphabet, Caterpillar, Instacart, Microsoft
items.excerpt: S&P 500 Index futures fall 0.3% as of 7:39 a.m. in New York as disappointing sales from Alphabet reignite concerns about the AI trade.

items.headline: AI Assistant Startup Wabi Raises $55 Million at $1.25 Billion Value
items.excerpt: AI assistant startup Wabi Inc. has raised $55 million at a $1.25 billion valuation to build out its software that lets groups of people interact with artificial intelligence agents to coordinate activities and make collective decisions.

items.headline: Big Tech Prepares for AI Regulation Fight After US Midterms
items.excerpt: AI leaders aligned themselves with Trump, which may not age well after next week’s midterm elections

items.headline: STMicro Forecasts Growth As Chip Demand Recovery Continues
items.excerpt: STMicroelectronics NV forecast fourth-quarter revenue growth as a recovery in chip demand continues after a prolonged slump.

items.headline: Europe’s Earnings Growth to Rival US for the First Time in Years
items.excerpt: Europe is gaining ground on the US this reporting season, with profit growth forecast within touching distance for the first time in more than three years.

items.headline: Marvell Is Said to Near Megadeal for Lumentum in AI Push
items.excerpt: Marvell Technology Inc. is in advanced talks to buy data center optics maker Lumentum Holdings Inc., according to people familiar with the matter, putting it on the cusp of a potential megadeal amid the race to scale up in the artificial intelligence sector.

items.headline: FuriosaAI Quadruples Value to $2.9 Billion in Nvidia Chase
items.excerpt: South Korean AI chip startup FuriosaAI quadrupled its valuation to $2.9 billion in a fresh funding round, bolstering its bid to challenge the likes of Nvidia Corp.

items.headline: Air Liquide’s Sales Grow on Sustained AI-Related Demand
items.excerpt: Air Liquide SA revenue grew to its highest in nearly four years, propelled by increased demand in its artificial intelligence-exposed unit.
